messages:
sarah_ledger: FYI invoiced vendor "Aarya Systems" (IN) submitted a USD invoice and explicitly requested gross-up for Indian withholding. Contract silent. Can tax confirm our play?

mike_taxes: tagging @taxbot and @chen_ops. Short answer: we generally withhold, not gross-up. Need PAN, TRC/Form 10F and a statement on service location before considering treaty relief.

andrea_procurement: vendor said they need gross-up to avoid shortfall on their payroll this month. They provided a screenshot of their local cashflow note. No contractual basis though.

sarah_ledger: pasted invoice excerpt: ```
Invoice: AARYA-INV-333
Vendor: Aarya Systems Pvt Ltd
GSTIN: 27PQRSX9876L1Z2
Amount: USD 6,250
Description: Platform integration hours
Vendor note: "Please gross-up for Indian withholding (10%) to ensure net amount received remains USD 6,250."
```

taxbot: Internal reference: India TDS on technical/consulting fees typically applies. DTAA can reduce withholding if TRC + 10F available; still need to collect documentation. See internal tax playbook (link).

chen_ops: Request PAN and TRC together with vendor attestation that work was provided outside India if they claim so. If they confirm India-sourced services, withholding applies at source per Indian rules.

mike_taxes: Action plan: 1) Sarah ask for PAN + TRC + service location attestation (signed). 2) Finance will not gross-up automatically. We withhold statutory rate and issue TDS certificate (Form 16A). If TRC/10F supports treaty relief, we can apply reduced rate after counsel signoff.

sarah_ledger: Requested docs at 10:03. Vendor replied at 10:28 with TRC attached and says work delivered from India. They again asked politely for gross-up.

andrea_procurement: Any chance we can offer payment on a shorter cycle to ease their cashflow instead of gross-up? Maybe 7-day instead of net30?

mike_taxes: We can offer alternate payment terms commercially, but tax position unchanged. Shorter payment doesn't negate withholding. Also avoid making tax-based concessions without legal review.

chen_ops: For the record, if we withhold and provide Form 16A, vendor should be able to claim credit in India. Document that to vendor.

mike_taxes: Agreed. No gross-up. Hold payment pending PAN validation and counsel memo about DTAA rate. Sarah please block payment in AP. :thumbsup:

sarah_ledger: Blocking payment and noting procurement ask about faster payment. Will update once external counsel responds or vendor provides additional docs.
